shared_elements: low-relief/linear figural carving on a rock surface
small schematic animal or creature figures
repeated comb-like rows of short strokes
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic figural carvings on stone, and A's quadruped in profile with smaller creatures below loosely parallels B's small figures and animal shapes; however B is dominated by large boat forms with rows of crew strokes, a motif entirely absent in A, whose central subject is a single large bull-like quadruped above a fox/reptile and a bird-like figure on a pillar. The organising schemes differ fundamentally—a vertical stack of isolated animals versus horizontally repeated vessels with attendant figures—so only the most generic correspondence (animals rendered schematically in outline/relief) holds.
